# Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 will end on September 1, 2027

## What Changed

On September 1, 2027 support for Java 8, 11 and 17 will end. Your apps that are hosted on App Service will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for Java 8, 11 and 17.Required actio

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This can create a customer delivery blocker or migration requirement.

## Customer Impact

**High**. Lifecycle: `deprecated`. Change type: `deprecated`.

## Recommended Action

Identify affected workloads, verify the effective date, and create a tested migration action.
